sequence.title: Sequence Diagram
sequence.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Boot as main and scheduler
  participant Example as example app_init
  participant Board as board demo startup
  participant AppTask as board demo task
  participant GPIO as board GPIO adapter
  participant Button as B1 PC13 and LEDs
  participant LwIPTask as LwIP startup task
  participant Stack as LwIP stack and Netif1
  participant Client as TCP echo client
  participant Server as TCP echo server
  participant Peer as remote TCP echo endpoint
  participant Log as printf UART console

  Boot->>Example: app_init creates LwIP, server and client tasks
  Example->>Log: app_logger_init and startup log output
  Boot->>Board: app_start initializes board GPIO
  Board->>GPIO: board_io_init configures PA5, PG1, PG2 and PC13
  Board->>GPIO: set initial LED states
  GPIO->>Button: HAL GPIO writes on PA5, PG1 and PG2
  Board->>AppTask: create board_demo_task
  Boot->>Boot: start FreeRTOS scheduler

  par LwIP interface startup
    LwIPTask->>Stack: mx_lwip_init and register Netif1
    Stack-->>LwIPTask: link and IPv4 address status callbacks
    LwIPTask->>Log: log interface and address status
    LwIPTask->>Client: signal IP available through event group
    LwIPTask->>Server: signal IP available through event group
  and Board input polling
    loop every 10 ms
      AppTask->>GPIO: read button and uptime
      GPIO->>Button: HAL_GPIO_ReadPin PC13
      AppTask->>AppTask: debounce button#59; toggle state on stable press
      opt boot blink interval elapsed and edges remain
        AppTask->>GPIO: write status LED state
        GPIO->>Button: HAL_GPIO_WritePin PA5
      end
      AppTask->>Log: button state log when press is stable
    end
  and TCP server
    Server->>Stack: wait for IP, then listen on TCP port 7
    loop wait for clients and serve connections
      Server->>Stack: select and accept client
      alt data received
        Server->>Stack: receive bytes and send them back
      else timeout, close or receive error
        Server->>Log: report timeout or connection result
      end
    end
  and TCP client
    Client->>Stack: wait for IP, resolve address and connect to port 7
    loop retry after configured connection delay
      alt connection succeeds
        loop up to five echo frames per connection
          Client->>Stack: send frame and receive echoed frame
          Stack->>Peer: TCP echo request
          Peer-->>Stack: echoed TCP data
          Stack-->>Client: received echo data
          alt buffers match
            Client->>Log: log echo completion
          else send, receive or comparison failure
            Client->>Log: log echo error
          end
        end
        Client->>Stack: close socket
      else connection fails
        Client->>Log: log connection failure
      end
      Client->>Client: delay 10000 ms before next attempt
    end
  end
